Senses.Explanation: The after-station of the moon-calendar formula that splits the month into before, after, and right at the fifteenth. Guyin Yuncong posts the frame that ruled the schools, buddhas born before the fifteenth and dead after it, with a hook for whoever leaves and an awl for whoever stays, and on the day itself both rest, Dahui Zonggao traces the frame to Yunmen Wenyan's own April-eighth address and reads why the eighth stands inside the unasked half while every day is the sage's birthday, Xutang Zhiyu closes the summer with rest barred before and staying barred after, so on the day itself neither works, Ying'an Tanhua has the water rise with the boat before and the mud buddhas grow fat after, and on the day itself one blow to the East Sea carp brings the rain down in basinfuls, and Gulin Qingmao digs for the sky before, carries water in a basket after, and on the day itself the sky brightens and the sun comes out. Liao'an Qingyu sets gain and loss, long and short before, and no high, no low, no side after, Miyun Yuanwu asks who would bother reckoning before and who dares be at ease after, Poshan Haiming serves them dripping pus before, dripping blood after, and dry and bare on the day itself, Feiyin Tongrong turns the past to worn traces before and the future past all hoping after, with the day itself showing true in every thing, and Shanduo Zhenzai gives the rhino its horn from toying with the moon before and the elephant its flower-teeth from the thunder after, and on the day itself the red-leaf temple and the white-cloud tower.
